flags.why: Bán thân means half-length or the upper half of the body; a bust or half-length portrait is tượng bán thân or chân dung bán thân.
flags.fix: half-length; showing the upper half of the body

flags.why: The verb biên nhận belongs to formal administrative usage and needs a register warning ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/bien-nhan-eiOMo9aGWbdmm.html)).

The common construction mang tiếng là also means being something in name or reputation without living up to it, rather than having a bad reputation ([dictionary](https://rongmotamhon.net/tu-dien_tieng-viet_smkctpgt_rong-mo-tam-hon.html)).
flags.fix: [colloquial] to be supposedly; to be something in name only
